apps.localizedDescription: Ūrjas is a private, offline, on-device health companion with WHOOP-style Recovery, Strain, Sleep and Stress insights — plus a Fitness Age panel, daily coaching suggestions and auto workout detection. All data stays on your device.
apps.versionDescription: Smarter sport prediction and a WHOOP-style workout Lock Screen. Auto-detected workouts now use your iPhone's motion, GPS speed and step cadence (with heart rate) to correctly name walks, runs and rides — and when it isn't sure, it labels the session 'Workout' and puts your most likely sports at the top of the picker instead of guessing wrong. The Live Activity is redesigned to match WHOOP: a running timer, live HR, a Zone 1–5 bar, and distance + speed for outdoor workouts.

versions.localizedDescription: Smarter sport prediction and a WHOOP-style workout Lock Screen. Auto-detected workouts now use your iPhone's motion, GPS speed and step cadence (with heart rate) to correctly name walks, runs and rides — and when it isn't sure, it labels the session 'Workout' and puts your most likely sports at the top of the picker instead of guessing wrong. The Live Activity is redesigned to match WHOOP: a running timer, live HR, a Zone 1–5 bar, and distance + speed for outdoor workouts.

Stricter, more reliable auto workout detection. Workouts now only auto-start after ~7 minutes of genuinely sustained effort (no more false starts from standing up or reaching for a glass), and auto-end when your HR calms, when the strap comes off / disconnects for a few minutes, or after a 4-hour safety cap — so a session can never silently run for days.

HR-based sport identification plus a workout Live Activity. Auto-started workouts now guess the sport from your heart-rate shape instead of always 'Other'; change the sport of a live or saved session; and while a workout records, the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island show the sport, live HR and current HR zone.

Live workout auto-start/auto-end: Ūrjas now starts a recording by itself when your HR stays elevated (any sport) and ends it when you cool down. Includes a fix so auto-started sessions reliably auto-end.
Ūrjas sideload build: NOOP→Ūrjas brand sweep, WHOOP-style Fitness Age panel, contextual coaching suggestions, auto-workout card on the home screen, and QA fixes.
